Problem Statement
Read an integer and print its square, by calculating the square inside a function that returns the result.
Description
Read an integer num from input. Write a function square that takes one integer parameter, multiplies it by itself, and returns the result. Call this function from main(), store the returned value in a variable, and print it.
Input Description
A single integer num (-1000 <= num <= 1000).
Output Description
Print the square of num.

5
